title: Example: try a sitting on the dash itself
intro: This is the example sitting that ships with the dash. It tests the thing you are looking at, so you can see how a sitting runs. Real sittings are written by the agent for work only a person can check.

signIn.note: The dash needs no sign-in on this machine. A real sitting names the test account to use here.

prerequisites: Have a screenshot, or anything you can take a screenshot of.

steps.title: Start the clock
do: Press **Start** at the top of this page.
expect: This step opens and its Pass, Fail and Skip buttons can be pressed.

steps.title: Add a note and a screenshot
do: Type a few words in the Notes box of this step.
Take a screenshot and drop it on this step, or paste it.
expect: A small Saved message appears after you stop typing.
The screenshot appears under the notes with a caption box.

steps.title: Reload the page
do: Reload this page in the browser.
expect: The clock carries on from where it was.
Your note, your screenshot and the results so far are all still here.

steps.title: Fail a step on purpose
do: Press **Fail** on this step and say why in the note.
expect: The step turns red and stays open so you can write the note.
The progress bar counts it as done.

steps.title: Finish
expect: The clock stops and a summary shows the time and the counts.
The agent hears about it at the start of its next session without you telling it.
